items.sentence: Before breakfast, the hungry dragon rubbed its round stomach.
The vet offered one tiny pill to the sleepy hamster.
A student raised her thumb to show the plan was fine.
One small bandage covered the wound on the puppy's paw.
Today, gentle swimming therapy helped the old dog walk again.
Today, the toy bear needed simple surgery from a young doctor.
Today, the kind physician listened to the child's steady heartbeat.
One positive attitude helped the team finish the long hike.
Today, the monkey will grab a banana from the low branch.
Today, climbers grip the rope with both hands going up.
